mil5.5.3:1.2: Aham-asmi bhikkhave brāhmaṇo yācayogo sadā payatapāṇi antimadehadharo anuttaro bhisakko sallakatto ti.
mil5.5.3:1.4: Etad-aggaṃ bhikkhave mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ appābādhānaṃ yad-idaṃ Bakkulo ti.
mil5.5.3:1.5: Bhagavato ca sarīre bahukkhattuṃ ābādho uppanno dissati.
mil5.5.3:1.6: Yadi bhante Nāgasena Tathāgato anuttaro, tena hi: Etad-aggaṃ bhikkhave mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ appābādhānaṃ yad-idaṃ Bakkulo
mil5.5.3:1.8: Yadi thero Bakkulo appābādhānaṃ aggo, tena hi: Aham-asmi bhikkhave brāhmaṇo yācayogo sadā payatapāṇi antimadehadharo anuttaro bhisakko
mil5.5.3:1.10: Ayam-pi ubhatokoṭiko pañho tavānuppatto, so tayā nibbāhitabbo ti.
mil5.5.3:2.2: Aham-asmi bhikkhave brāhmaṇo yācayogo sadā payatapāṇi antimadehadharo anuttaro bhisakko
mil5.5.3:2.4: Etad-aggaṃ bhikkhave mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ appābādhānaṃ yad-idaṃ Bakkulo
mil5.5.3:2.5: ti. Tañ-ca pana bāhirānaṃ āgamānaṃ adhigamānaṃ pariyattīnaṃ attani vijjamānataṃ sandhāya bhāsitaṃ.
mil5.5.3:3.1: Santi kho pana mahārāja Bhagavato sāvakā ṭhānacankamikā, te ṭhānena cankamena divārattiṃ vītināmenti, Bhagavā pana mahārāja ṭhānena cankamena nisajjāya sayanena divārattiṃ vītināmeti; ye te mahārāja bhikkhū ṭhānacankamikā te tena angena atirekā.
mil5.5.3:4.1: Santi kho pana mahārāja Bhagavato sāvakā ekāsanikā, te jīvitahetu pi dutiyaṃ bhojanaṃ na bhuñjanti, Bhagavā pana mahārāja dutiyam-pi yāva tatiyam-pi bhojanaṃ bhuñjati; ye te mahārāja bhikkhū ekāsanikā te tena angena atirekā. Anekavidhāni mahārāja tāni kāraṇāni tesaṃ tesaṃ taṃ taṃ sandhāya bhaṇitāni.
mil5.5.3:4.2: Bhagavā pana mahārāja anuttaro sīlena samādhinā paññāya vimuttiyā vimuttiñāṇadassanena, dasahi ca balehi catuhi vesārajjehi aṭṭhārasahi buddhadhammehi chahi asādhāraṇehi ñāṇehi. Kevale ca buddhavisaye taṃ sandhāya bhaṇitaṃ:
mil5.5.3:4.3: Aham-asmi bhikkhave brāhmaṇo yācayogo sadā payatapāṇi antimadehadharo anuttaro bhisakko
mil5.5.3:5.1: Idha mahārāja manussesu eko jātimā hoti, eko dhanavā, eko vijjavā, eko sippavā, eko sūro, eko vicakkhaṇo, sabbe p' ete abhibhaviya rājā yeva tesaṃ uttamo hoti;
mil5.5.3:5.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja Bhagavā sabbasattānaṃ aggo jeṭṭho seṭṭho.
mil5.5.3:6.1: Yaṃ pan' āyasmā Bakkulo appābādho ahosi, taṃ abhinīhāravasena. So hi mahārāja Anomadassissa bhagavato udaravātābādhe uppanne Vipassissa ca bhagavato aṭṭhasaṭṭhiyā ca bhikkhusatasahassānaṃ tiṇapupphakaroge uppanne sayaṃ tāpaso samāno nānābhesajjehi taṃ byādhiṃ apanetvā appābādhataṃ patto, bhaṇito ca: Etad-aggaṃ bhikkhave mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ appābādhānaṃ yad-idaṃ Bakkulo
mil5.5.3:7.1: Bhagavato mahārāja byādhimhi uppajjante pi anuppajjante pi, dhutangaṃ ādiyante pi anādiyante pi, na-tthi Bhagavatā sadiso koci satto.
mil5.5.3:7.2: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā devātidevena Saṃyuttanikāyavaralañcake:
mil5.5.3:8.1: Yāvatā bhikkhave sattā apadā vā dipadā vā catuppadā vā bahuppadā vā rūpino vā arūpino vā saññino vā asaññino vā nevasaññi-nāsaññino vā Tathāgato tesaṃ aggam-akkhāyati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho ti. -
mil5.5.3:9.1: Sādhu bhante Nāgasena, evam-etaṃ, tathā sampaṭicchāmīti.
